adapter_boundary: Host adapters measure topology and apply affinity, priority, power throttling, and worker limits. They never choose authority, urgency, service class, or terminal state.

topology.unknown_rule: Missing or stale topology is UNKNOWN and no P/E-specific allocation may be claimed.

reserve.purpose: Keep the operating system and interactive user responsive. The reserve remains outside ordinary allocations.

task_classes.latency_serial: Latency-sensitive or serial critical path; prefer P cores.
task_classes.interactive: User-facing work with a bounded response deadline; prefer P cores and preserve the UI reserve.
task_classes.throughput_parallel: CPU-parallel work with measured scaling; use a mixed P/E allocation.
task_classes.batch_background: Deferrable compute; prefer E cores and yield under pressure.
task_classes.io_background: I/O-bound acquisition, indexing, sync, or ingest; use E cores only by default.
task_classes.maintenance: Health checks, cleanup, polling, and convergence; use a small E-core allocation.
task_classes.safety_recovery: Authorized recovery whose delay increases measured harm; use P/E within the verified authority and duration.

authority.rule: Agent, harness, model, vendor, process, or seat identity never implies authority, importance, or urgency.

allocation.background_p_core_exception: A background task may borrow one P logical CPU only when p_core_required is true and the serial critical path is declared.
allocation.worker_rule: requested_workers and applied workers must not exceed allocated logical CPUs or the global concurrency cap.
allocation.pressure_rule: Sustained pressure downshifts deferrable/background work by at least one service class; urgent or critical work still preserves the ordinary reserve.
allocation.exclusive_rule: Using reserved logical CPUs requires hardware.compute.exclusive authority, explicit operator impact acknowledgement, a maximum duration of 900 seconds, restore-on-exit, and exact read-back.
allocation.hysteresis: Adapters must use sustained measurements and hysteresis; one instantaneous sample may not oscillate a task between classes.

localization.scope: One measured host. Local P/E numbers, project budgets, resident-process rules, and rider concurrency are host policy and are never portable constants.
localization.project_coverage_rule: Every top-level project with an AGENTS.md Outcome must have an explicit local profile, even when its observed resident allocation is zero.
localization.resident_rule: Registered, enabled, frequent, or important does not mean resident. Only a daemon or service expected to outlive multiple dispatch cadences is resident.
localization.rider_rule: Every HubClock rider invocation is scheduled_ephemeral. A rider may ensure a separate resident service, but the invocation itself remains ephemeral.
localization.controller_rule: HubClock and tray control processes use the resident_control baseline; descendants are classified independently.
enforcement: zero visible windows and zero focus steals
localization.unknown_rule: Missing project coverage, stale topology, an unmeasured resident claim, or an invalid local budget is UNKNOWN and cannot be promoted as a FAMES-localized profile.

background_execution.scope: Every scheduled task, rider, daemon, watchdog, updater, and every descendant process.
background_execution.python_launcher_note: pythonw hides the parent only; every console-capable descendant still requires hidden creation flags.
forbidden: shell fallback that can show a console

evidence_basis: Existing fleet_pe_allocator affinity, priority, power-throttling, and adaptive-profile implementation.
Existing acquisition_order cpu_tier separation for background acquisition and architecture work.
Existing adaptive-resource-governor AIMD, hysteresis, process-tree, and global-cap constraints.
Existing run-windows-subprocess-silently CREATE_NO_WINDOW and SW_HIDE constraints.
